# dsh-plugins
Personal unified plugin collection for DeepSeek Harness. All self-authored plugins live here in one
place, so a fresh machine can install everything with a single command.

## Adding a plugin

1. Create a directory under `plugins/` with the source
2. Add one line to the `link_plugin` list in

`install.sh`
3. Add a matching row to the `rows` table in `install.sh`
4. Commit

Note: the loadable bundle `dist/index.js` is committed (so a fresh machine needs
no build toolchain)
